repair_notes.counterexample_calculation: For L=(x=0), p=[0:0:1], the ideal (x)/(x^2,xy) sheafifies to k_p. Thus 0->k_p->O_X->O_L->0 gives h^0(O_X)=2. The graded resolution 0->S(-3)->S(-2)^2->S->S/(x^2,xy)->0 uses maps (-y,x) and (x^2,xy). Dualizing with O_P(-3) gives Ext^1_P(O_X,O_P(-3))=O_L(-2), since the kernel of (-y,x):O(-1)^2->O is generated by (x,y), with the preceding image its x-multiple. Thus h^1(omega_X)=1; Ext^2 is k_p, so D_X has a second cohomology sheaf and is not omega_X[1].
